post.description: Audio is transcribed (speech-to-text) and deleted; only the transcript is kept. The explanation is judged against the topic's key ideas by meaning (Uzbek-Russian mixing is fine). Passing needs at least 80% of the key ideas and no wrong statement. Missing ideas on the first answer → outcome `follow_up`: Sardor asks one question, answer it with this endpoint. Then `passed` (topic mastered) or `not_yet` (a short explanation and the next try in `next`; tries are unlimited). The 3rd not_yet since the last pass notifies the teacher.
